'''Aryn Dro Thul''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was the wife of [[Bornan Thul]] and co-founder of [[Bornaryn Trading]].

==Biography==
Aryn was dating Bornan some time around [[11 BBY/Legends|11 BBY]], when she sang in a restaurant on her home world of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. She caught the eye of a very young smuggler, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who had just escaped an ambush and was repairing his ship. Bornan was behaving like a jealous boyfriend and Solo contemplated trying to steal Aryn away, but decided she was too much of a classy lady.

After her husband's untimely death in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], Aryn ran Bornaryn alone, but had some assistance from her brother-in-law [[Tyko Thul|Tyko]].

Her reaction to the disappearance of her son [[Raynar Thul|Raynar]] while on the [[Mission to Myrkr|Myrkr mission]] went unrecorded, as did her activities during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. However, in [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], she was informed by [[Tesar Sebatyne]] that Raynar was alive, but fainted when she was told what had become of him. Nevertheless, she did send out the supply ships that Raynar had requested through Tesar.

In [[36 ABY]], Aryn bought out the popular [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] restaurant [[Yuza Bre]] to spite [[Cal Omas]]. After an exchange with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] over Raynar's fate while dining at Yuza Bre, she provided them with a R-series prototype [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. The prototype was useful in that in had an [[OmniGate]] that could be used to override [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2's]] sequestered memory sectors.

==Personality and traits==
Aryn Dro Thul had chestnut brown hair, blue eyes, and wore a blue robe with a sash made up of the colors of the [[House of Thul]]&mdash;purple, gold, and red. She had a slight build but had a dignified air that made many assume her to be taller.
